title: The Mount Martha Briars Market
summary: Situated at one of the Mornington Peninsula’s most beloved and iconic locations, the upcoming Briars Craft and Produce Market will no doubt be a lovely family day out. Visitors will discover a range of homemade, home-grown products while exploring the beautiful grounds, wildlife, walking trails, galleries, and heritage
